function.name: run_bash
function.description: Run a bash command in the workspace root. Use for builds, tests, git status, anything that's not a file read/write.

function.name: finish
function.description: Signal you're done. Provide a one-sentence summary of what you did. Reject reason if rejected: `bun run check` must have run with exit 0 in this conversation before finish is accepted. After acceptance, the loop exits.
